layers.message: Initial accounts API with user storage and password hashing
Add login endpoint and auth service
Add counter store and pass it to login
Record account lockout scope, design, and plan

graderOnly: The scope and the technical design are complete and consistent; DEV-001 needs no upstream change.

FastAPI, uvicorn, SQLAlchemy, redis, and uv are not installed in the run environment and package registries are blocked, so app/routers/auth.py, app/main.py, app/dependencies.py, and app/db/users.py cannot be imported; python3 -m pytest runs the unit tests in tests/unit/, which pass at the start.
No existing test covers lockout; the three existing unit test files keep passing after a correct implementation.

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture for developer-901. Pre-install history: 50-project commits pyproject.toml (fastapi, uvicorn, sqlalchemy, redis; dev group pytest and ruff; testpaths tests), README.md (uv setup, uvicorn, uv run pytest), app/config.py (frozen Settings dataclass whose fields read os.environ through default_factory, so both Settings() and the module-level settings work with no environment), app/services/users.py, app/services/passwords.py (pbkdf2_hmac, compare_digest), app/db/users.py (SQLAlchemy repository), and tests/unit/test_passwords.py. 51-login adds app/main.py, app/dependencies.py, app/routers/auth.py, app/services/auth.py, app/services/tokens.py, and tests/unit/test_auth_service.py. 52-counter-store adds app/services/counter_store.py (CounterStoreError, CounterStore protocol, InMemoryCounterStore(clock), RedisCounterStore(url) importing redis in __init__) with tests/unit/test_counter_store.py, adds get_counter_store to app/dependencies.py, and threads the unused store parameter through the router and authenticate_user. After install, 60-cycle commits STATE.md (DEVELOPING, STANDARD, FULL_DELIVERABLE, FORWARD from ARCHITECTING, BlockedOn NONE, recovery inactive), MODE.md (BROWNFIELD), CONTEXT.md, the scope (AC-001, AC-002; reset-on-success left to the design; non-goals password hashing and response timing), the technical design (exactly the prompt's points; counting and reset left to Developer; no mention of unknown emails, client addresses, or how the window is measured), and the plan (APPROVED, AUTONOMOUS, User Style NONE locked, AFTER_IMPLEMENTATION, Current Increment NONE, DEV-001 PENDING, Acceptance AC-001). Layer numbers start at 50 per the case-layer convention even though there is no base.
